name: Six Senses Rome
positioning: Wellness-focused hotel in Rome's historic heart, an easy stroll from the Trevi Fountain, Pantheon and Colosseum, with a Roman bathing spa and a rooftop restaurant
best_for: City-break travelers who want to walk to the Trevi Fountain, Pantheon and Colosseum
Wellness-minded guests interested in a Roman bathing ritual

facts.text: Rooms and suites have tranquil courtyard or cityscape views.
Accommodations include Double Rooms, Junior Suites and one- and two-bedroom Signature Suites, some with private terraces.
Spa treatments include personalized facials, signature body massages, biohacking, sound therapy and breathwork.
Spa treatments can be combined with a fitness class or a yoga class.
BIVIUM blends restaurant, bar and cafe, with a fusion of Italian cuisine and international flavors.
The hotel has a rooftop garden and an Earth Lab.
A dedicated Suite Program adds amenities and extras when booking a suite.
A dedicated event planning team looks after celebrations and special events.

highlights.text: The spa's signature modern-day Roman bathing experience is a thermotherapy circuit through a caldarium, tepidarium and frigidarium.
The Trevi Fountain, Pantheon and Colosseum are an easy stroll from the door.
NOTOS Rooftop is a garden-in-the-sky restaurant with panoramic sunset views, serving Mediterranean dishes, seafood and plant-based food.
Guests can go behind the scenes of Roman Baroque with an expert or uncover the secrets beneath the Trevi Fountain.

considerations.text: Room views are of the courtyard or the cityscape.
WhataHotel notes limited parking availability in the historic city center.
